[b]Have you ever felt like the only person in Pelican Town who knows how to give a gift?
[/b]
[b]Gift Back[/b] is a lightweight, immersive mod that adds a chance for NPCs to immediately return the favor when you give them a present. It integrates seamlessly into the game flow—waiting for the conversation to finish before surprising you with a token of their appreciation.

[center][img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdGFqb2Foanc2bHp3OXpvdXdxaXhnbXVnYTJuYmI5OTdheXllbmFoMiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/wgGa8qv8YMswz0nVWt/giphy.gif[/img]﻿﻿[/center]

[b]How It Works
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]The Hook:[/b] Immediately after you hand a gift to an NPC, the mod calculates a chance for them to gift you back.
[*][b]The Timing:[/b] The mod is polite! It waits for the gift dialogue box to close, waits a fraction of a second, and then places an item in your inventory with a satisfying sound effect.
[*][b]The Daily Limit:[/b] To prevent abuse, each NPC can only gift you back [b]once per day[/b].
[*][b]Smart Item Selection:[/b] The mod pulls from the game's object list with intelligent weighting:
[/list][list]
[list]
[*][b]Cheap items[/b] (crops, basic resources) are common.
[*][b]Expensive items[/b] (gems, rare goods) are very rare.
[*]Items are capped at a max value (Configurable) to prevent game-breaking drops.
[/list][/list][b]Friendship Matters (Default Settings)
[/b]
By default, the mod is configured for a "Vanilla+ / Balanced" experience. Strangers usually won't give you anything, but your best friends might!

[list]
[*][b]Base Chance:[/b] 1% (Very low for strangers)
[*][b]Scaling:[/b] +0.5% chance per Friendship Heart.
[/list][b]The Math:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]0 Hearts:[/b] 1% chance.
[*][b]4 Hearts:[/b] 3% chance.
[*][b]8 Hearts:[/b] 5% chance.
[*][b]10 Hearts:[/b] 6% chance.
[/list]Note: These values are fully configurable! If you want a "High Loot" game, you can crank the base chance up to 100% in the settings.

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41023/41023-1767918571-1826386403.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[b]Configuration (GMCM)
[/b]
This mod supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]. You can change every setting in-game without restarting.

[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod:[/b] Turn it on/off.
[*][b]Base Chance:[/b] Set the starting probability (0% to 100%).
[*][b]Enable Scaling:[/b] Decide if friendship should affect the chance.
[*][b]Chance Per Heart:[/b] How much extra probability a heart is worth.
[*][b]Max Gift Value:[/b] The maximum gold value of items received. (Default: 500g).
[/list]

[center]﻿[youtube]oTq9DsjcE8Q[/youtube][/center][b]Installation
[/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*](Optional but Recommended) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to adjust the gift rates.
[*]Run the game!
[/list][b]Compatibility
[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].
[*]Works in [b]Multiplayer[/b] (Each player handles their own gifting logic).
[*]Safe to add or remove from an existing save at any time.
[/list]
